title: SurgicGuide Reaches End-of-Phase 2 Milestone with FDA
html:
SurgicGuide Limited recently participated in an End-of-Phase 2 (EOP2) meeting with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to discuss the development of its FLIM- and AI-based surgical guidance platform for precision cancer surgery.

Representing SurgicGuide were Sum, Tsz-tak, Chief Executive Officer; Chan, Kin-lam, Chief Medical Officer; and Leung, Ho-bank, VP, Regulatory Affairs. The team discussed Phase 2 clinical data, the proposed Phase 3 study design, clinical endpoints, statistical considerations, and key regulatory requirements for further development.

The meeting provided an opportunity to address key questions regarding the proposed Phase 3 programme and align on the next steps in SurgicGuide's clinical and regulatory strategy.

"The EOP2 meeting provides an important opportunity to align on our Phase 3 development strategy and address the key questions ahead." — Sum, Tsz-tak, CEO, SurgicGuide Limited

Advancing Precision. Guiding Surgery. Improving Outcomes.
